title: Agent 01 Prospect Dossier
description: Structured output contract produced by Agent 01 (Scout & Pain Detector) for handoff to Agent 02 (Solution Architect).

prospect_id.description: Unique lowercase slug in format <niche>_<city>_<business-slug> (e.g., roofing_austin_acme-roofing).

scouted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp indicating when the prospect was audited.

business_name.description: Verified legal or DBA name of the local service business.

state.description: State, province, or region (e.g., TX, FL, ON).

website_url.description: Verified live primary website URL of the business.

decision_maker.description: Verified full name of the decision-maker, or 'Unknown' if not publicly listed.

role.description: Decision-maker title (e.g., Owner, President, General Manager, or Unknown).

email.description: Publicly listed business email address, or 'Not publicly listed'.

contact_page_url.description: Direct URL to the business contact or quote request page.

primary_color_hex.description: Primary brand color extracted from the prospect's live site/CSS/logo.

secondary_color_hex.description: Secondary/accent brand color extracted from the prospect's live site/CSS/logo.

brand_vibe.description: Concise visual and tone descriptor (e.g., 'Family-owned trustworthy', 'Corporate modern', 'Storm-response urgent').

has_instant_quote_tool.description: Qualified Trojan Horse prospects must NOT already have an interactive instant quote calculator (must evaluate to false).

mobile_ux_issues.description: Concrete mobile UX or conversion friction points observed directly on the live site.

seo_or_speed_leaks.description: Observed technical SEO, metadata, speed, or trust/CRO deficiencies.

current_lead_capture_method.description: Summary of how the prospect currently captures leads (e.g., static Contact Us form + click-to-call phone number).

recommended_solution.description: Identifier of the recommended micro-tool blueprint (Wave 1: 'TYPE_A_ROOFING_CALCULATOR').

pitch_hook_english.description: One concrete, non-salesy English sentence pointing out the exact conversion leak observed on their site.

proposed_setup_fee_usd.description: Recommended one-time implementation fee in USD.

proposed_retainer_usd.description: Recommended recurring monthly maintenance, routing, and hosting retainer in USD.
